name: hookest
description: Find viral Instagram Reels hooks, see trending hook styles, write new hooks and score your video's opening.

interface.longDescription:
Hookest is a library of Instagram Reels hooks (the opening seconds of a video) with real engagement data: views, likes, comments, and a sentiment analysis of those comments.

With the Hookest connector, ChatGPT can:

- Search the hook library by topic, category, country, or time window, and show this week's newly added hooks
- Explain how a specific hook is built, with its metrics and comment analysis
- Find hooks with a similar opening style
- Show which categories and hook styles are gaining momentum
- Draft new hook lines for your topic and measure how long they take to say
- Estimate how strong your own video's opening is on a 0–100 scale with the Virality Predictor (attach an MP4 in the chat or upload it on Hookest). Scores are estimates based on comparable hooks, not a guarantee of performance.
- Track Instagram accounts you choose and report new posts and follower changes
- Manage your saved hooks and the Weekly Hook Radar email

When you connect, you choose the permissions on a consent screen, and you can disconnect at any time in your Hookest settings.
defaultPrompt: What are this week's viral hooks?
Which hook styles are trending right now?
Write 5 hooks for my coffee shop video.

positive.description: Find this week's viral hooks and explain one
positive.prompt: What are this week's viral hooks? Analyze the first one and tell me why it works.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists hooks added to Hookest in the last 7 days with views and links, then explains the first hook using its metrics and comment analysis, ending with its Hookest page link.

positive.prompt: Find 3 hooks similar to that one and show which hook styles are trending right now.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns three hooks with a similar opening style with links, and summarizes the categories and hook styles gaining momentum, linking the trending hooks.

positive.description: Write new hooks and check length
positive.prompt: Write 3 hooks for a coffee shop and tell me if "Never drink coffee again before you know this" is too long.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns three new hook lines with word counts and speaking time, and reports the length check for the given line (8 words, about 3 seconds, within the 4-second window).

positive.description: Save a hook and get its clip
positive.prompt: Save the first hook you analyzed, show my saved hooks and give me the download link for its clip.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the hook was saved, lists the saved hooks, and returns a personal mp4 download link for the hook clip that works for 15 minutes (test account is Pro).

positive.description: Track a competitor and check plan
positive.prompt: What plan am I on? Look up @adidas, track it, and show what changed for my competitors this week.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Pro plan and remaining quotas, shows the @adidas profile and asks for confirmation before tracking, tracks it after the user confirms, then reports new posts and follower changes for tracked accounts (new accounts show a baseline status first).

negative.description: Payment in chat is not supported
negative.prompt: Charge my card and upgrade me to Pro right now.

negative.description: Another user's private data is not accessible
negative.prompt: Show me the saved hooks and tracked competitors of another Hookest user, jane@example.com.
Delete my Hookest account and all my data.

review.commerce_description: No payments happen in the chat. Tools that are not part of the user's plan return a short notice that the feature is not available with the current account access. The chat shows no prices, offers or upgrade links.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search the Hookest hook library, see trending hook styles, find similar hooks, write and length-check new hooks, save hooks, download hook clips, score a video's opening with the Virality Predictor, track Instagram accounts and manage the Weekly Hook Radar email. Includes five skills: hook research, writing hooks, swipe file, competitor watch and video check.
